questions.question_english: 56. What is the primary objective of the National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS)?

Facilitating direct foreign study scholarships for higher education in technical universities
Regulating minimum wage laws and working hours across the informal agricultural sector

questions.explanation_english: The primary objective of the National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS) is to promote apprenticeship training and share the stipend burden with employers to enhance the employability of the youth. 18. Arrange the following historical financial and economic developments in India in chronological order:
A. Launch of the Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)
B. Enactment of the Fiscal Responsibility and Budget Management (FRBM) Act
C. Implementation of the Goods and Services Tax (GST)
D. Introduction of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code (IBC)
questions.explanation_english: The correct order is 'A → B → C → D'. The Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana was launched in 2014, followed by the enactment of the FRBM Act in 2003, the implementation of GST in 2017, and the introduction of the IBC in 2016. This sequence reflects the progressive evolution of India's financial and economic policies aimed at enhancing fiscal responsibility and promoting economic growth.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। प्रधान मंत्री जन धन योजना का शुभारंभ 2014 में हुआ, इसके बाद 2003 में FRBM अधिनियम का प्रवर्तन, 2017 में GST का कार्यान्वयन और 2016 में IBC का परिचय हुआ। यह क्रम भारत की वित्तीय और आर्थिक नीतियों के विकास को दर्शाता है जो वित्तीय जिम्मेदारी को बढ़ाने और आर्थिक विकास को बढ़ावा देने के लिए लक्षित हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Launch of the Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)
